result.summary: The page is largely coherent, but horizontal carousel content is clipped awkwardly and the fixed bottom navigation obscures part of the restaurant feed.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the second restaurant card, hiding a substantial portion of its image and potentially its details or controls.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable feed based on the navigation bar and safe-area height so content can scroll fully above it.

issues.description: The category row ends with an unexplained partial pill at the right edge, which looks like a cut-off or empty control.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent horizontal carousel padding and ensure enough of the next chip, including its label, is visible—or clip it completely.

issues.description: The third card in “Fastest near you” is heavily cropped, including its restaurant name, making the row look truncated rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card widths and spacing so the next card has a clearer carousel preview, and add right-side padding to prevent text from ending directly at the viewport edge.
